units.source_text: 傍晚时分，源氏公子眺望着鸦雀无声的暮天。

en.t: Toward evening, Prince Genji gazed out at the silent dusk sky where not even a bird cried.

units.source_text: 夕颜觉得室内太暗，阴森可怕，便走到廊上，把帘子卷起，在公子身旁躺下。

en.t: Yugao felt that the room was too dark and eerily frightening, so she went out to the veranda, rolled up the blinds, and lay down beside the prince.

units.source_text: 两人互相注视被夕阳照红了的脸。

en.t: The two of them looked at each other's faces, flushed red by the setting sun.

units.source_text: 夕颜觉得这种情景之奇特，出乎意外，便忘却了一切忧思，渐渐地显出亲密信任之态，样子煞是可爱。

en.t: Yugao found the strangeness of the scene so unexpected that she forgot all her worries, gradually showing an air of intimate trust, and she looked exceedingly lovely.

units.source_text: 她看到周围的情景，觉得非常胆怯，因此尽日依附在公子身边，像一个天真烂漫的孩子，十分可怜。

en.t: Seeing her surroundings, she felt terribly timid, and so she clung to the prince all day like an innocent child, which made her very touching.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便提早把格子门关上，教人点起灯来。

en.t: Prince Genji therefore had the lattice shutters closed early and ordered the lamps to be lit.

units.source_text: 他怨恨地说：“我们已经是推心置腹的伴侣了，你还是有所顾忌，不把姓名告诉我，真教我伤心。”

en.t: He said reproachfully, "We are already companions who have opened our hearts to each other, yet you still hold back and will not tell me your name. It truly pains me."

units.source_text: 这时候他又想起：“父皇一定在找寻我了吧，教使者们到哪里去找我呢？”

en.t: At that moment he thought again, "His Majesty my father must surely be looking for me. Where will he send the messengers to find me?"

units.source_text: 既而又想：“我何以如此溺爱这女子，自己也觉得奇怪。

en.t: Before long he thought again, "Why am I so infatuated with this woman? Even I find it strange.

units.source_text: 我久不访问六条妃子，她一定恨我了。

en.t: I have not visited the Rokujo lady for a long time; she must surely hate me now.

units.source_text: 被人恨是痛苦的，然而也怪不得她。”

en.t: It is painful to be hated by someone, yet I cannot blame her for it."

units.source_text: 他怀念恋人时，总是首先想起这六条妃子。

en.t: Whenever he thought fondly of his lovers, this Rokujo lady was always the first to come to mind.

units.source_text: 然而眼前这个天真烂漫、依恋不舍的人，实在非常可爱。

en.t: Yet the innocent, clinging woman before his eyes was truly very dear to him.

units.source_text: 此时想起六条妃子那种多心过虑令人苦闷的神情，便觉稍稍减色了。

en.t: When he now recalled the Rokujo lady's anxious, overly suspicious expression that made others feel oppressed, she seemed somewhat less appealing.

units.source_text: 他在心中把两人加以比较。

en.t: In his heart, he compared the two women.
